options.query:
| tstats `pan_summariesonly` 
    latest(_time) AS _time, 
    values(log.log_subtype) AS log_subtype, 
    values(log.severity) AS severity, 
    values(log.app) AS app, 
    values(log.user) AS user, 
    values(log.threat_name) AS threat_name, 
    values(log.file_name) AS file_name 
    values(log.bytes_in) AS bytes_in, 
    values(log.bytes_out) AS bytes_out, 
    values(log.direction) AS direction, 
    values(log.src_zone) AS src_zone, 
    values(log.dest_zone) AS dest_zone, 
    values(log.action) AS action, 
    count FROM datamodel="pan_firewall" WHERE (nodename="log.traffic.end" OR nodename="log.file") by sourcetype log.serial_number log.session_id log.client_ip log.server_ip 
| rename log.* AS *

search log_subtype="file" AND action="blocked" 
| stats sum(count) as count

search log_subtype="file" AND action="Allowed" 
| stats sum(count) as count

| mvexpand action
| eval time_in_seconds=_time
| eval Time = strftime(_time, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S")
| rename action AS Action, app AS App, client_ip AS "Client IP", server_ip AS "Server IP", user AS User, file_name AS "File Name", session_id AS "Session ID", serial_number AS "Serial Number", src_zone AS "Source Zone", dest_zone AS "Destination Zone", count as Count
| table Time Action App "Client IP" "Server IP" "File Name" "Source Zone" "Destination Zone" 
| sort -Time

| stats sum(bytes_in) AS "Total Bytes In" sum(bytes_out) AS "Total Bytes Out" sum(count) AS count by app 
| rename app as App, count as Count
| sort - Count

search log_subtype="file" AND action="*" 
| stats sum(count) as count

| mvexpand bytes_in
| stats sum(bytes_in) AS "cbytes" sum(count) AS count by log.client_ip 
| eval "Inbound Bytes (MB)"=round(cbytes/1024/1024, 2)
| table log.client_ip "Inbound Bytes (MB)"
| sort - Count

| tstats `pan_summariesonly` 
    latest(_time) AS _time, 
    values(log.log_subtype) AS log_subtype, 
    values(log.severity) AS severity, 
    values(log.app) AS app, 
    values(log.user) AS user, 
    values(log.threat_name) AS threat_name, 
    values(log.file_name) AS file_name 
    values(log.bytes_in) AS bytes_in, 
    values(log.bytes_out) AS bytes_out, 
    values(log.direction) AS direction, 
    values(log.src_zone) AS src_zone, 
    values(log.dest_zone) AS dest_zone, 
    values(log.action) AS action, 
    count FROM datamodel="pan_firewall" WHERE (nodename="log.traffic.end" AND log.client_ip!="$local_range$" AND log.client_ip!="$remote_range$") by sourcetype log.serial_number log.session_id log.client_ip log.server_ip

| tstats `pan_summariesonly` 
    latest(_time) AS _time, 
    values(log.log_subtype) AS log_subtype, 
    values(log.severity) AS severity, 
    values(log.app) AS app, 
    values(log.user) AS user, 
    values(log.threat_name) AS threat_name, 
    values(log.file_name) AS file_name 
    values(log.bytes_in) AS bytes_in, 
    values(log.bytes_out) AS bytes_out, 
    values(log.direction) AS direction, 
    values(log.src_zone) AS src_zone, 
    values(log.dest_zone) AS dest_zone, 
    values(log.action) AS action, 
    count FROM datamodel="pan_firewall" WHERE (nodename="log.traffic.end" AND log.client_ip="$local_range$") by sourcetype log.serial_number log.session_id log.client_ip log.server_ip

| mvexpand bytes_out
| stats sum(bytes_out) AS "cbytes" sum(count) AS count by log.client_ip 
| eval "Outbound Bytes (MB)"=round(cbytes/1024/1024, 2)
| table log.client_ip "Outbound Bytes (MB)"
| sort - Count

| timechart per_minute(bytes_in) as bytes_in, per_minute(bytes_out) AS bytes_out
| eval "Inbound MB"=round(bytes_in/1024/1024, 2), "Outbound MB"=round(bytes_out/1024/1024, 2)

| tstats `pan_summariesonly` 
    latest(_time) AS _time, 
    values(log.log_subtype) AS log_subtype, 
    values(log.severity) AS severity, 
    values(log.app) AS app, 
    values(log.user) AS user, 
    values(log.threat_name) AS threat_name, 
    values(log.file_name) AS file_name 
    values(log.bytes_in) AS bytes_in, 
    values(log.bytes_out) AS bytes_out, 
    values(log.direction) AS direction, 
    values(log.src_zone) AS src_zone, 
    values(log.dest_zone) AS dest_zone, 
    values(log.action) AS action, 
    count FROM datamodel="pan_firewall" WHERE (nodename="log.traffic.end" OR nodename="log.file")         by sourcetype log.serial_number log.session_id log.client_ip log.server_ip 
| rename log.* AS *

| timechart per_minute(bytes_in) as bytes_in, per_minute(bytes_out) AS bytes_out
| eval "Inbound MB"=round(bytes_in/1024/1024, 2), "Outbound MB"=round(bytes_out/1024/1024, 2)

| tstats `pan_summariesonly` 
    latest(_time) AS _time, 
    values(log.log_subtype) AS log_subtype, 
    values(log.severity) AS severity, 
    values(log.app) AS app, 
    values(log.user) AS user, 
    values(log.threat_name) AS threat_name, 
    values(log.file_name) AS file_name, 
    values(log.bytes_in) AS bytes_in, 
    values(log.bytes_out) AS bytes_out, 
    values(log.direction) AS direction, 
    values(log.src_zone) AS src_zone, 
    values(log.dest_zone) AS dest_zone, 
    values(log.action) AS action, 
    count 
    FROM datamodel="pan_firewall" 
    WHERE (nodename="log.traffic.end" OR nodename="log.file")         
    by sourcetype log.serial_number log.session_id log.client_ip log.server_ip 
| rename log.* AS * 
| search (bytes_out>0 OR bytes_in>0) AND client_ip="10.50.50.*"
| rename bytes_out AS sbytes
| timechart span=1m sum(sbytes) AS Volume_per_minute
| eval Volume_MB=round(Volume_per_minute/1024/1024, 2)
| from datamodel:User_Detail.Created |stats  count by Dest_Account |search Dest_Account!="*$"|stats c as Total
| from datamodel:User_Detail.Deleted  |stats  count by Dest_Account |search Dest_Account!="*$"|stats c as Total
| from datamodel:User_Detail.Updated  |stats  count by Dest_Account |search Dest_Account!="*$"|stats c as Total
| from datamodel:User_Detail.Disabled  |stats  count by Dest_Account|search Dest_Account!="*$" |stats c as Total
| from datamodel:User_Detail.Locked  |stats  count by Dest_Account |search Dest_Account!="*$"|stats c as Total
| from datamodel:User_Detail.Enabled  |stats  count by Dest_Account |search Dest_Account!="*$"|stats c as Total

| from datamodel:"$change$"
| eval "Event Time"=strftime(_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
| rename Src_Account as "Source Account"  Dest_Account as "Destination Account" Msg as "Message"
| table " Event Time" "Source Account" "Destination Account" "ComputerName" Domain Message
|search "Source Account"!="*$"
|search "Destination Account"!="*$"
